title: Health and Disease
summary: What health means, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and the different ways infections spread.

ib.note: Pathogen biology follows in MYP 5 / DP

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 3: Health: The Ultimate Treasure
Earlier NCERT Ch 2: Microorganisms: Friend and Foe

objectives: I can describe health as physical, mental and social wellbeing.
I can distinguish communicable and non-communicable diseases.
I can describe how diseases spread through air, water, contact and vectors.
misconceptions: If you don't feel ill, you are healthy.
All diseases are caused by germs.
Diabetes can be caught from someone else.
